# Bounded historical table and planner helper review

The corrected V2 passes this bounded helper/source review. Frozen manifest SHA-256 `c1fd4a561531088d12e5a6db27ef7d2818194fa36b0ab7c13999bdbb54991a3c`; patch SHA-256 `da1cd006f3bf71a8c0beb9a4efcf151bd9aa094717c1c19ab4ad7a43feef07ea`. All six manifest members matched declared hashes and sizes. The exact three-file checkout diff matched the patch before and after the independent probe; `git apply --check` passed canonical `b22786175e97f7e250bfb4f212a1f91eadbfaed2` during review. No canonical file was changed.

The V1 constructor mismatch is corrected: the exact signature path now compares its reconstructed `ab78...` prior and current `fc44...` image through the same physically authenticated `assertImage` method exercised by the targeted test. Planner proof pins and replays the exact Git-backed planner transition; the table proof pins its commit, before/after bytes, reviewed receipt and the one added row, and requires the prior JSON structure to remain identical. The table qualifier permits only the two exact identities, validates byte counts and metadata shape, rejects proxies/accessors/extra keys, and rereads the current physical file. The report-count path retains the original 14-change baseline and accounts for the one exact old-current table identity, rejecting duplicates and unknown table identities; this part was source-reviewed only.

An independent pinned Node 24 run of `tests/historical_repair_table_planner_successor_probe.mjs` passed all 20 recorded controls, including main and historical planner routes, exact prior/current qualification, malformed metadata, physical drift and symlink rejection, and both valid and invalid `assertImage` inputs. The independent log is `probe-v2.log` in this directory. The author's immutable diagnostic logs show the complete owner still fails earlier on separate stale select/menu inputs; the complete constructor did not reach the image branch and no complete report-count runtime was executed.

This review is limited to the helper and its exact successor. It does not establish complete historical-owner, current-head, global TOOL, CI, product, peer-range, G11 or release qualification. The historical owner's pre-existing callback behavior was not reviewed or hardened here.
